thread:
maria: noticing steady RSS growth on streaming-chat with tool loops. 50 long sessions, after ~12h avg process rss +1.8GB. Repro in staging. Non-eviction? paging? :eyes:

devon: can you share reproduction steps & pprof heap? did you enable kv-compactation? @maria

maria: repro: `tool-loop-sim --sessions 50 --length 20k --streaming true`

maria: uploaded heap snapshot /tmp/heap-179812.pgz (staging). summary shows increasing counts of `kv_segment` objects and many small unreachable fragments.

ryan: saw something similar in nightly. flamegraph shows hot paths in kv_cache append and a lot of small allocations that never get returned to OS. might be fragmentation + per-connection arenas.

chen: note we switched eviction to a soft-evict mode (threshold 85%) recently to avoid IO during spikes — that delays reclaim. lowering threshold should make evictions more aggressive.

sasha: also remember kernel selector change a couple weeks ago (avx512 kernels enabled for some models) — certain attention cache sizes changed which moves allocation sizes between slab bins, could make fragmentation worse.

devon: can you paste pprof top and a quick `smem` snapshot? :thinking_face:

ryan: pprof top (heap):
```
25.3%  kv_cache::Segment::append
18.7%  kv_cache::Node::new
12.1%  attention::KVCache::reserve
8.4%   runtime_malloc
... (truncated)
```

ryan: smem on the runner shows RSS for process 2345: 3.2GB -> 5.0GB over ~10h; swap negligible.

maria: tried forcing `kv_cache.compact()` every 5k tokens in staging -> immediate drop ~300MB but growth resumed slowly. so compaction helps but is not permanent.

chen: could be stale references from streaming iterator closures holding onto slices across async work. grep for closures capturing `seg.slice` or similar.

maria: found one in tool_loop.go:412: `keepRef := func() { ... cached := seg.slice }` — closure captures seg backing memory and schedules background work.

devon: good catch. hotfix plan: copy the slice before scheduling background goroutine / background job so closure doesn't retain entire segment. small patch should fix quickly.

maria: rolling patch to staging now (PR linked in thread). deploy bot: infra-bot, please start deploy to staging.

infra-bot: deploy started by maria — https://deploy.internal/redeploy/179812

sasha: add diagnostic metric: `kv_fragmentation_ratio = free_bytes / total_bytes` per host and a rolling alert if ratio < 0.2 for > 30m. will help catch before OOM-like drift.

maria: after patch: staging process RSS stabilized for 6h (no further upward trend) on the 50-session test. still running a 48h soak. will post final results.

devon: follow-up: audit other tool-loop closures and add a unit test that runs a long synthetic stream to catch retention via closures.

ryan: created backlog task and flagged for priority: add long-stream unit, run under memory profiler in CI. tagging eng-runtime.

maria: created issue RED-1234: "streaming tool-loop closure holding KV slice -> slow RSS drift" and linked patch/PR.

chen: note: this is orthogonal to quantization/kernel selection perf work, but interactions exist — keep an eye on slab histograms when we change kernels.

maria: thanks all :heart: will update once 48h soak completes.
